title: Evaluation tree on a majority block
statement: For a block index $b\in\{0,1,2\}$ and a seed $s\in\{0,1,2\}$, define a decision tree on nine sign coordinates by transporting the cyclic three-input majority tree with seed $s$ into block $b$. Its available coordinates are exactly the image of the three coordinates in that block under the canonical block embedding.
hypotheses_covered: Block index is one of three values
Seed is one of three values
caveat: The formal statement refers to the cyclic majority tree, whose defining construction is not included in the supplied definitions.
